critical_code_review_comments: demo_slots._lead_for_request: upserts a Lead keyed by demo_request_id (or email fallback) and only resets demo_slot/demo_status when missing or previously 'annullata' — prevents duplicate leads on repeated confirm. OK.
demo_slots._sync_request: idempotent — if lead already 'confermata'/'riprogrammata' with meet 'ok', it is reused; if meet failed previously, performs 'meet' retry only. Clean separation.

demo_booking.apply_action: _lock first (releases on cancel, raises SlotTaken on conflict with video_support_bookings), then updates lead + propagates status to demo_request + sends operational email (dedup via demo_email_key). Correct order.

demo_booking.meet_for_demo: in simulation returns deterministic 'https://meet.google.com/sim-...' + demo_meet_status='ok'; without connected calendar returns demo_meet_status='errore' with Italian message. Verified via unit code review (not reachable in preview with sim ON).
booking_counts filter uses Europe/Rome now_key and ACTIVE statuses — matches task spec (excludes cancelled/past).
Frontend Layout.jsx polls /platform/booking-counts every 60s AND listens to 'bookings:changed' window event — verified by badge going 2->1 instantly after cancel.
Minor: on reschedule error 409 the UI surfaces via alert (BookingShared); acceptable since this is a rare edge case.
